samples.summary: Todo checklist left fully unchecked though the paired lessons file and the rest of the PR indicate the work described was completed.
samples.evidence: All items under 'Acceptance criteria' (lines 9-16) are `- [ ]` unchecked, e.g. '- [ ] Toolbar gains **Foldout**, **Code**, **Quote** buttons.' Yet `packages/notes/src/view/commands.ts` already defines `insertFoldout`, `insertCodeBlock`, `toggleQuote`, `notes-toolbar.tsx` already renders `IconFold`/`IconCode`/`IconBlockquote`, `notes-preview.css` already has the flat `.note-details` styling described, and `docs/design/notes/notes.md` already documents the shipped feature — all consistent with the plan being executed, so the checkboxes appear stale relative to the rest of the change.
